title: 第307章 圆满第306章 一起洗
slug: 我在修仙世界成了香饽饽
content_zh:
屋外天光正好、市井喧嚣，屋内结界封闭、岁月温柔，从此再无半点打扰，唯有彼此，静静相守……
结界稳固的刹那，杨欢才抬手褪去衣衫，动作从容舒缓，不疾不徐，没有半分急促。
挺拔紧实的身形显露在氤氲水汽之中，筋骨利落，身姿挺拔，周身温润气场与屋内缱绻氛围完美相融。
他抬步缓缓迈入浴桶，温水漫过周身，暖意融融，可肌肤相触的温热，远比水温更动人。
两人咫尺相对，呼吸交缠，眼底情愫脉脉流转，无需言语，便知彼此心意。
这一刻，席一悠率先卸下了所有拘谨。
她眸光缱绻似水，一瞬不瞬凝着身前之人，眼底满是温柔纵容。
不等他俯身靠近，她便抬起纤细白皙的指尖，缓缓拉扯着湿透的纱衣。
动作缓慢轻柔，一点点褪去身上最后一层遮掩，举止坦荡温顺，自带韵味，却无半分刻意轻浮。
轻薄白纱脱离肌肤，随水波轻轻漂浮在水面之上。
桶中清水微微荡漾，细碎波纹流转，映得她肌肤莹润白皙，肌理细腻匀净，身姿窈窕温婉，每一寸线条都自然天成，温柔绝色，风月无双。
一室白雾氤氲，一池温水含春，密闭结界之内，风月悄然盛放，缱绻温柔，层层蔓延。
杨欢俯身缓缓靠近，终于将连日隐忍的温柔尽数付诸相拥。
温热的躯体轻轻贴合，肌肤相触的触感细腻滚烫，彼此的心跳紧紧相依、共振交融，沉稳又热烈，一点点击碎所有克制，温柔却有力量。
唇齿轻轻相衔，初时温柔浅尝，缓缓摩挲、缱绻试探，没有急切的纠缠，只有慢慢升温的情愫。
唇齿相依间，呼吸不断交缠，暖意顺着相触的肌肤蔓延全身。
席一悠温顺依偎在他怀中，抬手轻轻环住他的脖颈，指尖轻柔划过他的肩背，温柔回应，步步相融，全然沉沦在这份温存之中。
浴桶之内水波轻晃，细碎水声温柔细碎，轻轻回荡在密闭的卧房之中。
两人相拥温存，肢体相缠，呼吸交叠，所有的温柔、遗憾、期许尽数融入此刻的缠绵里，节奏舒缓绵长，风月缱绻，氛围感层层递进。
温热清水流转，周身爱意悄然滋生、缓缓交融。

两人本就心意相通，此刻肉身相契、神魂共生，灵力顺着肌肤触碰缓缓流转、彼此滋养，不急不躁，润物无声，既温存风月，亦淬炼道基。
水中温存许久，情愫愈发浓稠绵长。
杨欢俯身，稳稳将怀中人抱起，带起满桶细碎水花，温润水汽顺着交缠的身躯缓缓滴落。
他步履沉稳舒缓，抱着软若无骨的席一悠，一步步走向床边，每一步都藏着温柔的珍视。
软床锦被柔软温热，落满一室温柔天光。
杨欢俯身，轻轻将席一悠安置在床上，随即缓缓俯身贴近，再度低头衔住她柔软的唇瓣。
content_en:
The sky outside is perfect, the market is noisy, the boundary inside the house is closed, and the years are gentle. From now on, there will be no interruptions, only each other, staying together quietly...
The moment the barrier was firmly established, Yang Huan raised his hand and took off his clothes. His movements were calm and slow, neither fast nor slow, not hasty at all.
The tall and tight figure is exposed in the dense water vapor, with neat muscles and bones, a straight posture, and a warm aura around the body that perfectly blends with the lingering atmosphere in the room.
He slowly stepped into the bathtub, and the warm water spread over his body, making him feel warm. However, the warmth of skin contact was far more touching than the temperature of the water.
The two of them were close to each other, their breaths intertwined, and the emotions in their eyes were flowing. They knew each other's feelings without the need for words.
At this moment, Xi Yiyou took the lead in letting go of all his restraints.
Her eyes were as gentle as water, focusing on the person in front of her for a moment, her eyes full of tenderness and indulgence.
Before he could lean over, she raised her slender white fingertips and slowly pulled the soaked gauze.
The movements were slow and gentle, and the last layer of covering on the body was peeled away little by little. The behavior was open and gentle, with its own charm, but without any deliberate frivolity.
The thin white gauze separates from the skin and floats gently on the water with the water waves.
The clear water in the bucket rippled slightly, and the fine ripples flowed, reflecting her radiant and white skin, delicate and even texture, graceful and graceful figure, every inch of the line is natural, gentle and beautiful, unparalleled in beauty.
A room filled with white mist, a pool of warm water filled with spring. Within the sealed boundary, the wind and moon were quietly blooming, lingering and gentle, spreading layer by layer.
Yang Huan leaned forward and slowly approached her, finally embracing her with all the tenderness she had been holding back for days.
The warm bodies are gently pressed against each other, and the touch of skin is delicate and hot. Each other's heartbeats are closely dependent on each other, resonating and blending, calm and warm, breaking all restraints bit by bit, gentle but powerful.
The lips and teeth touch each other gently, the first gentle taste, the slow caressing, the lingering exploration, there is no eager entanglement, only the slowly warming emotion.
As their lips and teeth depended on each other, their breaths kept intertwining, and warmth spread throughout the body along the touching skin.
Xi Yiyou meekly snuggled into his arms, raised her hands and gently wrapped her arms around his neck, her fingertips gently brushed his shoulders and back, responding tenderly, blending in step by step, completely immersed in this tenderness.
The water in the bathtub swayed gently, and the soft sound of the water gently echoed in the sealed bedroom.
The two embrace each other tenderly, their limbs are intertwined, and their breaths overlap. All the tenderness, regret, and expectations are integrated into the lingering moment. The rhythm is slow and long, the wind and moon are lingering, and the sense of atmosphere is advancing layer by layer.
The warm and clear water flows, and the love around you quietly grows and blends slowly.
The two people are connected in mind. At this moment, their bodies are in harmony and their souls are symbiotic. Their spiritual energy flows slowly along the touch of their skin, nourishing each other. They are neither impatient nor impetuous, moisturizing things silently. They not only preserve the wind and moon, but also temper the Tao foundation.
The warmth in the water lasts for a long time, and the feelings become thicker and longer.
Yang Huan leaned over, picked up the person in his arms steadily, and brought up a bucket full of fine water splashes. The warm water vapor slowly dripped down the entangled body.
He walked calmly and leisurely, holding the soft and boneless Xi Yiyou, walking towards the bed step by step, with gentle cherishment hidden in every step.
The soft bed and quilt are soft and warm, filling the room with gentle skylight.
Yang Huan leaned over and gently placed Xi Yiyou on the bed, then slowly leaned forward and leaned close to her, lowering his head again to capture her soft lips.
